# Computing Binomial Probabilities with **R** (I)
You may use the following R Chunk below to compute normal distribution probabilities.  The functions you will need is pnorm().  BE SURE YOU STANDARDIZE NORMAL RANDOM VARIABLES BEFORE USING THIS FUNCTION.  


```{webr-r}
# Evaluating P(Z > 0)
# Z ~ N(0,1)
pnorm(0, lower.tail = FALSE)
```
